title: Live CDP DOM Inspection & Hydration Protocol
procedure: 1. Connect to Chrome over CDP on port 9222.
2. Locate target page tab without hijacking user tabs.
3. Check for lazy-loaded containers: scroll container into viewport and wait 1500ms for DOM hydration.
4. Query child elements using pinpointed selectors.
5. Dump exact classes, attributes, text contents, and SVG icon statuses into a temporary audit artifact.
6. Verify against user screenshots before codifying into production logic.
